summary: Completed comprehensive testing of ERP Efatech system. Login functionality works correctly, dashboard loads properly, but significant navigation and session management issues identified. Several modules are accessible while others redirect to login.

ui_bugs.issue: Menu items have href='#' instead of actual routes, preventing navigation via sidebar clicks

integration_issues.issue: Session expires quickly causing redirects to login page when navigating to protected routes
Inconsistent route accessibility - some modules work (Estoque, Orçamentos, Contratos, Atendimentos, Notas, Relatórios, Configurações) while others redirect to login

design_issues.issue: Chart components show width/height warnings in console

passed_tests: Dashboard loads with proper greeting and financial cards
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix session management issues causing redirects to login page for protected routes. Update sidebar navigation links to use proper hrefs instead of '#'. Investigate why some modules (Clientes, Produtos, Fornecedores, Financeiro, Serviços, Ordens de Serviços) are not accessible while others work correctly.
